title: InfMasking: A Unified Variational Framework for Synergistic Multimodal Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.07702v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal models are expected to exploit synergistic information, that is, information available only when multiple modalities are observed together. In practice, however, a fusion module can fit the training objective by relying on a dominant modality or on information that modalities share, and the synergy between modalities is often left unused. We propose InfMasking, a unified multimodal learning framework based on Infinite Masking. Before fusion, InfMasking randomly masks the features of each modality; each sampled mask produces a different partial combination of cross-modal evidence and a fused representation of the corresponding modality interactions. All masked fused representations are required to remain consistent with a reference target: the unmasked fused view when training is unsupervised, and the class proxy of the task label when labels are available. Maintaining this consistency across diverse partial combinations disc

translated_title: InfMasking：协同多模态学习的统一变分框架
translated_abstract: 多模态模型被期望能够利用协同信息，即只有在同时观察多个模态时才能获得的信息。然而在实践中，融合模块可以通过依赖某个主导模态或模态间共享的信息来拟合训练目标，模态之间的协同性往往未被利用。我们提出了 InfMasking，一个基于无限掩码的统一多模态学习框架。在融合之前，InfMasking 随机掩码每个模态的特征；每个采样的掩码会产生一种不同的跨模态证据部分组合，以及对应模态交互的融合表示。所有被掩码的融合表示都需要与参考目标保持一致：当训练是无监督时，参考目标为未掩码的融合视图；当标签可用时，参考目标为任务标签的类别代理。在多样的部分组合上维持这种一致性促使模型（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了 InfMasking，一个基于无限随机掩码的统一变分多模态学习框架，通过在融合前随机掩码各模态特征，并要求所有被掩码的融合表示与参考目标（无监督时为完整融合视图，有监督时为标签类别代理）保持一致，从而迫使模型充分利用模态间的协同信息，而非依赖主导模态或共享信息。
en_tdlr: InfMasking is a unified variational multimodal learning framework that randomly masks modality features before fusion and enforces consistency between all masked fused representations and a reference target (the unmasked fused view in unsupervised training or class proxies when labels are available), compelling models to exploit synergistic cross-modal information rather than relying on dominant modalities or shared information.
